description: Write files with 85% token reduction through verification, atomic operations, and change tracking

atomic.description: Use atomic write with temporary file

content.description: Content to write to the file

createBackup.description: Back the file up before overwriting. Backups go to a home-directory root, never beside the file.

createDirectories.description: Create missing parent directories instead of failing

encoding.description: File encoding used to write the file

formatType.description: Formatter to run on the written content

mode.description: POSIX file mode for a newly created file, for example 420 for 0o644

path.description: Path to the file to write

returnDiff.description: Return diff instead of full content

tempDir.description: Directory for the temporary file used by the write-then-rename

trackChanges.description: Record this write in the change log used by the diff tools

ttl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds for the refreshed entry

updateCache.description: Refresh this file in the read cache after writing

verifyBeforeWrite.description: Skip write if content is identical

name: smart_write
